purpose: Pre-Unity cinematic-intent QA for CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1. These checks protect authoring truth and do not replace Unity validation. The status model is GREEN exact, YELLOW deterministic auto-repair/minor, ORANGE visible semantic or preview degradation, RED only when an honest result cannot safely continue.

validationStatusModel.principle: Color describes what happens to the film; owner describes who can fix it. Only RED blocks Editable Preview.

green.label: EXACT
green.meaning: The authored intent can be represented as requested.

yellow.label: AUTO_REPAIRED
yellow.meaning: The backend changed or supplied a deterministic low-level mechanic without materially changing visible semantic intent.

orange.label: SEMANTIC_DEVIATION
orange.meaning: The film can continue, but the visible result or preview differs materially from authored intent. Never substitute another identity to hide the deviation.

red.label: CANNOT_SAFELY_PRODUCE
red.meaning: No honest legal result can continue without invalid identity, invented data, incompatible CURRENT truth, or unrecoverable semantic corruption.

ownershipModel.AUTHORING: The JSON/CURRENT authoring choice is invalid and ChatGPT can fix it from published authoring truth.
ownershipModel.BACKEND: The backend owns deterministic normalization, source-provenance preservation, subject binding and generated-role projection.
ownershipModel.ENGINE: The authored identity is valid but Unity/editor/runtime execution could not realize it. Do not tell ChatGPT to change valid JSON merely to hide this.
ownershipModel.rule: A known exact CURRENT identity that later fails resolver/materialization is ENGINE-owned. A legal Simple V1 source whose semantic route/subject is lost by adaptation is BACKEND-owned. Neither is automatically an AUTHORING RED.

editablePreviewGate.orangeBehavior: Continue Editable Preview using an explicit diagnostic placeholder or omission owned by the preview/materializer. Preserve the exact authored identity in diagnostics. Do not select a replacement asset.
editablePreviewGate.freezeAcceptedJson: Once authoring integrity is accepted, downstream YELLOW/ORANGE backend or engine findings do not require regenerating or rewriting the source JSON.

redIsReservedFor: destination route/capability mismatch that cannot be materialized or honestly degraded
schema or semantic corruption with no deterministic legal repair
invented visual/3D evidence that contradicts CURRENT
camera subject genuinely missing or ambiguous after legal deterministic subject binding/defaults are exhausted
validationSeverityPolicy.principle: Do not turn backend implementation loss into authoring RED when source truth is legal. Fix provenance/binding before strict V3 validation.

simpleV1Semantics.cameraSubject: camera.subject is semantic authoring truth. Bind it to the generated V3 entity or Dialogue Stage participant before V3 validation. ChatGPT never authors V3 entity IDs.
simpleV1Semantics.sourceProvenance: A handle resolved through Actor/Layer/Ui/Effect/Audio keeps that route downstream; generated legacy role labels do not replace authoritative Simple V1 source provenance.
simpleV1Semantics.cinematicMove: Maps to existing V3 Beat/Feature vocabulary when exact; otherwise preserve visible evidence and lower-level legal actions without lying about a feature.
simpleV1Semantics.cameraOrbit: 2D/2.5D orbit-like parallax only. Never synthesize an unseen 3D side/back view.
simpleV1Semantics.dialogueShotPreset: Raw cameraCue.shotPreset is backend-owned. Blank generated presets are deterministically defaulted before strict contract validation.
simpleV1Semantics.dialogue: Dialogue-only curated participants remain Dialogue Stage anchors and do not become WorldActors merely to satisfy camera or legacy character-role validation.

rules.description: Simple V1 omitted camera.subject but exactly one deterministic primary semantic subject exists; backend binds it before V3 validation.
Simple V1 authored a legal camera subject but backend-generated V3 state lost or failed to bind that subject. Preserve source JSON and repair the adapter/provenance path.
No authored or deterministic unambiguous semantic camera subject can be established without guessing.
A Simple V1 Actor route overrides a conflicting generated legacy structural role for downstream capability validation.
A missing/blank backend-generated dialogue cameraCue.shotPreset was deterministically selected from existing presentation semantics before contract validation.
Simple V1 authored Push/Pull but backend-selected locked dialogue staging requires legal Hold; normalization occurs before V3 validation.
A deterministic Dialogue Stage background was supplied by the backend.
A deterministic Dialogue Stage frame was supplied by the backend.
Exact authored CURRENT identity is valid and preview-safe, but Unity could not materialize it. Continue with placeholder/omission and preserve identity.
Legal Simple V1 Actor source could not be projected into canonical backend Actor proof. This is backend-owned unless the original Simple V1 handle itself is invalid.
The camera/creative focal target has no visible or entering evidence in the beat.
A camera move names a subject that is never visibly present during the beat.
Orbit intent invents a 3D viewpoint, back side or model geometry not present in CURRENT visual evidence.
audio[].handle does not resolve exactly to CURRENT route Audio.
The requested dialogue presentation cannot obtain a legal deterministic stage/background/frame through the existing dialogue-stage owner.
A legal cutscene can continue, but visible authored intent cannot be reproduced exactly and is downgraded to a disclosed legal presentation.

hardAuthoringInvariants: AUTHORING_HANDLES.json is the only Simple V1 handle source.
Simple V1 does not author runtime assetId/GUID/revision/hash or raw V3 entity IDs.
Unknown or ambiguous handles remain RED.
A legal Simple V1 Actor route must not later be reinterpreted as Cutscene.Prop solely because of a generated legacy role label.
Curated DialoguePortrait participants with spawnWorldActor=false must not be forced through generic WorldActor Character/Crew checks.
Simple V1 camera.subject must survive adaptation and bind to the generated semantic entity or Dialogue Stage anchor before V3 validation.
V3_CAMERA_SUBJECT_REQUIRED remains strict; do not weaken it to compensate for adapter data loss.
If camera.subject is omitted and exactly one deterministic primary subject exists, backend may YELLOW-default it; otherwise do not guess.
Blank backend-generated dialogue shotPreset is YELLOW-defaulted before strict contract validation; explicit non-blank invalid values remain strict failures.
Known exact CURRENT identity plus downstream preview resolver/materialization failure is ENGINE ORANGE for Editable Preview, not AUTHORING RED.
